what: An experimental, self-playing additive instrument for generative, evolving soundscapes. 64 sine partials switched by two cellular automata, strikes, a two-path split with vowel and band-pass filters, Serge-style modulators, logic and sequencers, patched through mod and gate matrices. 12 bit, 22kHz, phosphor CRT, Fairlight-style pages.
author: Zeptosecond DSP
